audit.why: Difficulty EVEN / 5.5/10 matches the 49.6% win rate over 373 games. Early lane favours Neeko (Viktor is a 600-range immobile laner before augments), levels 4-5 and two items favour Viktor.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text names Viktor's E as 'Death Ray' and his R as 'Chaos Storm'.
audit.why: Riot Data Dragon has E = Hextech Ray (525 range, 12/11/10/9/8s) and R = Arcane Storm (700 range, 120/100/80s). Both shipped names are wrong.
audit.corrected: Hextech Ray and Arcane Storm used throughout spikes, mid, late, whys[5] and wants.foe[2].

audit.whatIsWrong: Gravity Field is described as rooting Neeko out of her combo; spikes[1] writes 'Gravity Fields' as a verb.
audit.why: Gravity Field (W, 17/16/15/14/13s, 800 range) slows on contact and only stuns enemies who remain inside it. It does not root, and stepping out of the zone denies the stun entirely - that is the whole all-in decision in this lane.
audit.corrected: Field slows then stuns you mid-combo; step out and the zone is spent.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit at all.
audit.why: The field exists to carry real numbers. Gravity Field 17s to 13s, Hextech Ray 12s to 8s, Arcane Storm 120/100/80s are the three windows that decide when Neeko may step up.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[0].d, dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were the cooldowns/tradeGood/tradeBad strings pasted under unrelated titles.
audit.why: Copy-paste bleed: the title promises one thing and the body explains another.
audit.corrected: Each bullet rewritten to match its own title, grounded in Viktor's kit.

audit.whatIsWrong: Viktor's Q Siphon Power is a shield plus auto-reset and the page never states it.
audit.why: Siphon Power (9/8/7/6/5s, 600 range) shields him and empowers his next basic attack, so raw Neeko Q poke on a 9s-to-7s cooldown into a refreshed shield loses the exchange.
audit.corrected: tradeBad now states the shield and cooldown maths.

audit.whatIsWrong: full-layer phases[0..6].side were all 'Skill' while content win[0..6] read Neeko/Neeko/Neeko/Viktor/Skill/Neeko/Viktor.
audit.why: The two layers are the same row and rendered two different answers. The packet levelChart agrees with the content layer, so the full layer is the stale one.
audit.corrected: full sides flipped to match content, with each why rewritten in the same group.

edits.before: - Viktor Gravity Field: matchup-defining — The stun zone owns every all-in — walk out the moment it drops or fight outside it. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your W Shapesplitter clone like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Gravity Field is 17s at rank 1 and 13s at rank 5: it slows first and only stuns if you stand in it, so step out and his 800-range zone is spent. - Hextech Ray is 12s down to 8s — his wave clear and poke both live on it. - Arcane Storm is 120/100/80s; fight after it.

edits.before: Track Viktor’s Gravity Field: The stun zone owns every all-in — walk out the moment it drops or fight outside it. Forward steps wait for its downtime.

edits.before: Once Viktor augments his Q Siphon Power he gets a shield and an empowered auto that wins short trades, and his E Death Ray shoves waves and pokes from range. Your E-Q all-in still threatens him, but he's starting to farm safely under tower and out-range your poke; step up when Hextech Ray is down (12s at rank 1).

edits.before: This is roughly even and skill-dependent: your R Pop Blossom all-in can kill him, but Viktor's Chaos Storm is a strong zoning ult and his augmented W Gravity Field roots you out of your combo. Whoever lands their CC first wins — if you E him before he Ws you, you kill; if he Gravity Fields your engage, you die.
edits.after: This is roughly even and skill-dependent: your R Pop Blossom all-in can kill him, but Arcane Storm is a strong zoning ult and Gravity Field slows then stuns you mid-combo. edits.before: You spike harder on a single item: Luden's/Blackfire Neeko can E-Q-R burst Viktor before his Chaos Storm ramps, and he's immobile with only Gravity Field to peel. Shove and force the all-in while you out-tempo his scaling.
edits.after: You spike harder on a single item: Luden's/Blackfire Neeko can E-Q-R burst Viktor before his Arcane Storm ramps, and he's immobile with only a 17s Gravity Field to peel. Shove and force the all-in while you out-tempo his scaling.

notes: The brief's missingInteractions claims Arcane Storm is a channel that Neeko's E or R can cancel. That is a derived-flag misfire: Riot's own text says Arcane Storm INTERRUPTS enemy channels and can be redirected by Viktor - it is not itself described as a channel. I did not write that interaction anywhere; it is listed in unverified. Riot Data Dragon names Viktor's E 'Hextech Ray' and R 'Arcane Storm'; the shipped page used 'Death Ray' and 'Chaos Storm' throughout. The full layer's level chart was entirely 'Skill' while the content layer and packet.levelChart both read Neeko/Neeko/Neeko/Viktor/Skill/Neeko/Viktor - the full layer is fixed to match, with every why rewritten in the same group. Ratings left untouched: the existing rating scale is not self-consistent across matchups, so I could not tell which direction a change should move. 'ahead', breakdown.wave, breakdown.mid and breakdown.feeding read as templates but Viktor gives nothing specific enough to reground them without inventing.
